title: BC3CAT-RETRIEVAL: retrieval and evaluation code for the BC3CAT parametric construction catalog benchmark
description:
Code, configurations and evaluation artefacts of the study A Systematic Comparative Study of Retrieval Methods for Parametric Construction Catalogs: From Lexical to Neural Approaches. The benchmark is built from the 47,513 items of subcategory OEB of the ADIF railway price catalog, and every system is scored at two levels: the exact parametric variant (item) and its template family (parent).

The release contains the lexical, neural, hybrid, reranking, HyDE and structured-matching implementations, the YAML configuration of every run, the versioned query sets (16,590 test and 5,000 validation queries, identified by SHA-256), the dual item/parent evaluator, the scripts that build the manuscript's tables and figures from the run artefacts, and the manuscript source.

The catalog with its parsed parameters and the BC3/FIEBDC conversion tools are released separately as the BC3CAT dataset.
